summary: Iteration 2: Tested all new AutoParts features - Resend emails, Object Storage uploads, PayPal redirect, admin auctions management, new admin email migration. 30/31 backend tests pass (1 skipped due to no cheap product). All critical frontend flows verified.

minor.issue: Resend in test mode (using onboarding@resend.dev sender) only allows sending to the verified admin email (billionsmahmoud@gmail.com). Customer confirmation emails to non-admin recipients FAIL with: 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address... please verify a domain at resend.com/domains'. Error is logged but non-blocking. Admin notification email sends OK because it goes to billionsmahmoud@gmail.com. To send confirmation emails to real customers, a verified domain must be configured in Resend and SENDER_EMAIL updated.
Returns 404 via ingress (root /api/ not routed). Non-blocking.

issues: Chat widget is correctly hidden when user is logged in as admin (uses data-testid='chat-widget-open' on public/customer pages). Verified visible on logged-out home page.

action_items: Configure verified Resend domain to allow customer confirmation emails (currently only admin notification works because of Resend test-mode restriction). Update SENDER_EMAIL in /app/backend/.env once domain verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1707 lines - urgently split into modules (auth, products, orders, files, auctions, chat, admin) for maintainability.

/app/backend/server.py:1175 hardcodes BACKEND_URL fallback 'https://auto-parts-shop-72.preview.emergentagent.com' inside upload_image. Use env var only without default to avoid stale URLs in production.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec - browsers may reject credentialed requests. Set explicit origins.

Order paypal_url is added to response object AFTER the order doc was inserted into DB - it's only returned in the API response, not persisted. If user navigates back to /paypal/:orderId after refresh, the page will need to reconstruct the URL from order.total + payment_method (PayPalInstructionsPage must do this independently). Confirmed working: page builds paypal.me/billions44/AMOUNTEUR client-side from order.total.

Resend send_email in /app/backend/server.py is async but uses the sync resend SDK - ensure not blocking the event loop on slow Resend responses. Consider running in run_in_executor or use httpx async.

rca of the issue: Resend customer email failure RCA: The Resend account is in 'test mode' using the default 'onboarding@resend.dev' sender. Resend's free/test tier only permits sending to the verified account email (billionsmahmoud@gmail.com). When customer.email != billionsmahmoud@gmail.com, Resend rejects with 403/422. This explains why admin notifications succeed but customer confirmations fail. Fix: verify a domain in resend.com/domains, then update SENDER_EMAIL='noreply@your-verified-domain.com' in /app/backend/.env and restart backend. The send_email function already wraps errors in try/except so this is non-blocking for order creation.
